startersHint: A starter sets the wording and shows the columns it expects. Change any line.
writeHint: Put a column heading in curly brackets where each person's detail should go, for example {name} or {amount}. Add |inr after a number for rupees, like {amount|inr}. Use {date} for today's date.
subject: Subject line
addresseeHint: Printed above the subject. One line each.
business: Name of the school or business
logoFailed: That picture could not be read. Try a PNG or JPG.
checkTitle: Check the letter against your list
missingField: no column with this heading in your list
noList: Add your list above to check the fields. The preview shows sample rows until then.
missing: Fix the fields marked red: add a column with that heading, or change the letter.
whyNoList: To enable this button, add your list above: paste it, upload a file, or tap Use the sample list.
whyBrackets: To enable this button, replace the parts in [square brackets] in the letter, including the signature and subject: {list}
brackets: Replace the parts in [square brackets] with your own words: {list}
tooMany: The most you can make at once is {max} letters. Split your list into parts.
previewSample: The preview uses a sample row until you add your list.
nameFiles: Name each file after the column

outputs.zip: Zip with a PDF for each person

outputHint: A zip lets you send each person only their own letter. Each page is about 0.2 MB, so a long list makes a big file.
failed: The letters could not be made. Please try again.
notSelectable: The text in the PDF is part of the page picture, so it cannot be selected or searched. Keep your list as the original.
notSaved: Your letter wording and letterhead are remembered on this device. Your list is never saved or uploaded.
introList: Each row of your list makes one letter. Column headings become the curly-bracket fields you use in the letter.
